description: Get the dealer gamma-exposure (GEX) and pin-risk map for one US ticker from live Tradier option chains: long/short gamma regime, zero-gamma flip line, call and put walls, max open-interest pin strike, and the full per-strike GEX ladder. Use this when an agent needs to know where options dealers are forced to hedge, for example before judging whether a move is likely to be dampened or amplified. An unsigned call returns the live x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge (USDC on Base; the challenge states the exact price) and never auto-spends; retry only with a challenge-specific payment_signature. If no chain, spot price, or open interest exists, it returns an honest not-available result and nothing is charged. A supplied signature authorizes one paid, irreversible x402 settlement. Informational market structure, not investment advice. For example, check SPY's zero-gamma line before the open.

payment_signature.description: Canonical x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE bound to this exact challenge.

symbol.description: US equity or ETF ticker, e.g. SPY, GME, NVDA.

name: gamma_sonar

outputSchema.description: Canonical REST response envelope, or a local/transport rejection. Upstream data remains in body and is defined by the live capability schema.

body.description: Unmodified upstream JSON, or bounded response text. Consult that capability's live schema.

charged.description: Present on local/transport failures; these do not establish an upstream charge.

ok.description: Whether the upstream HTTP status is 2xx; not settlement proof.

payment_required.description: Observed PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; a challenge does not prove payment.

payment_response.description: Observed PAYMENT-RESPONSE header. Assess it together with accepted delivery.

status_code.description: Observed upstream HTTP status, or null when no response was obtained.
